_about: Issue #628: rows another pull request is adding (#625) and that are not on main yet. The allowlist and the dashboards may name a row only when it is in code or here. Fields come from the branch's code (set A) or from the issue's spec (set B, no branch pushed when this was written). Remove an entry once its row is on main; kit.py --check reports entries that are.

BG_POPULATION.frequency: every 5 min, one per battleground and realm (about 144 an hour)
BG_POPULATION.meaning: Bots present per battleground and realm, by goal, beside the expected headcount (#610).

CAST_INTERRUPT.frequency: every 10th cast an attacker's interrupt timer reached, at most 20 a minute
CAST_INTERRUPT.meaning: A sampled cast an interrupting hit reached: caster kind, spell type, time left, kept or lost (#596).

CC_BREAK.frequency: each break of a mez or breakable root, at most 20 a minute
CC_BREAK.meaning: A mez or breakable root broken: breaker kind, ally or enemy of the caster, ms since it landed (#621).

BG_TARGET_PICK.frequency: every 10th battleground pick, at most 10 a minute
BG_TARGET_PICK.meaning: A sampled battleground target pick: the kind picked, controlled enemies and engines skipped, rally board or not (#621).

BG_RALLY_RESPONSE.frequency: each rallied bot's first engage of a posted contact, at most 10 a minute
BG_RALLY_RESPONSE.meaning: Time from a contact posted on a battleground rally board to a rallied bot's first attack (#621).

PLAYER_LINE_OUTCOME.frequency: each line the player types to bots, at most 30 a minute
PLAYER_LINE_OUTCOME.meaning: Whether any bot answered the player's line within 30 s, how fast, and how.

REALM_LEVEL_SPREAD.meaning: Gamebot count and levels gained per realm and band, re-rolled or new bots flagged (#544).

GROUP_ENDED.meaning: Why a gamebot group ended, how long it ran, its size at start and end, and its task (#544).

ECONOMY_PULSE.meaning: Exchange listings, sales and median price by slot band, and gamebot coin earned and spent.

STUCK_HOTSPOT.meaning: The top stuck or recovery spots by region and a rounded position grid, merged across bots and recovery kinds (#555).
